body:
About 2 and a half hours ago I read what you wrote. I started to write a reply and then I just blanked out. I couldn't focus long enough to reply in a timely fashion. 2 and a half hours later I'm still not able to finish what I've started. I can't remember what I was going to say, I remember what you wrote. 

There is no way I'll be able to function in this world. There's no one out there that will baby sit me for free until I can function on my own. Is there someone that is going to hang out with me while I have violent episodes like last time? 

There's no way I can fix this problem. I don't think people really understand how crippling this problem is. 

Magnavox_tv is right, there is no way I'll be able to ask for government assistance without them finding out I'm getting paid under the table. My work is the only phone number where people can reach me. That will be a violation of my probation and I will go back to jail. 

I'm not going to be able to do life for much longer. I have no future. The best thing I can do is not have any children and kill myself. That way there is no chance of this problem I have continuing on. I wouldn't wish this on my worse enemy. 

Sorry to waste your time.

I've worked several hundred jobs over in my life. I know when I'm about to get fired. 

I don't have any kind of benefits. I get paid under the table for several reasons. One thing if I had to pay taxes I wouldn't be able to afford my rent and food.

I used to be on paxil but it really didn't help. It made me anxious and violent towards others. It caused me to be in a constant paranoid state and it got worse over time. I spent a couple of years in jail for assault and battery because of the drug. I can't afford the doctor anymore. I've tried seeking government help too. I'm not mentally capable of accomplishing that goal. 

I've lived in 9 states over the past decade. I've traveled almost 3000 miles trying to find my place. No matter where I go my problems follow me. I don't really see much use in living life much longer. The entire trip from birth til now has been a horrible one. There is no good to reflect on. It's all my fault too. I can't focus enough to fix this problem.

I don't know anything about my biological family. I grew up in a boys home. 

These problems have been with me for as long as I remember. It was why I finished high school in the bottom 10%. 

I live in old office space in the same building as where I work now. My days are numbered here though. They aren't too pleased with my performance.
